name: Song of the Abyss
source:
A short form yuri romance told from the perspective of Cnidra, a deep sea jellyfish mermaid living in the back of a research-based aquarium. 

When a new intern unexpectedly hears the otherwise quiet Cnidra's Song that her silent, unchanging daily life is shaken. She begins to think about the great expanse outside of her tank and her role within it.

[From [url=https://stardust-and-snowflakes.itch.io/song-of-the-abyss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部简短的尤里爱情故事，从Cnidra的角度讲述，Cnidra是一只生活在研究型水族馆后面的深海水母美人鱼。

当新来的实习生意外听到原本安静的Cnidra之歌时，她平静、一成不变的日常生活被动摇了。她开始思考水族箱外部的广阔空间以及她在其中的角色。

[来自[url=https://stardust-and-snowflakes.itch.io/song-of-the-abyss]Itch.io[/url]]
